narrative: The acceptance branch port/sunstoneos-acceptance-on-split is based on CPU engine revision 0cbc96950; the recorded result uses SunstoneOS e124d65f and the paced image uses 8008acb1. One recorded 57,440-sample input on port 3-1 (entry 1793516356151336408-cac6790a) returns normally with seven secondary CPUs off and complete reference parity: 90 frames, transcript "There was silence.", compute 135.673 ms against the 179.5 ms limit. A paced replay of the same input passes six fresh native sessions (control 1793560017211439012-ff8c6091 and repeats 1793560102532814944-02caa432, 1793560276720214904-91d5e0c3, 1793560482537824782-7589f457, 1793560555177262469-0e251bd4, 1793560636888545789-06c0bafb) with full segmented parity, complete version 2 thermal reports and rail cleanup; median compute is 92.670 ms. These runs do not qualify corpus latency, retained-state replay, sustained multi-utterance capture or thermal and fault recovery. The metadata watcher path issue is worked around with the direct-result workaround in cadence-1101/metadata-watch-note.md.
